lead.headline: Dow's Plaquemine, Louisiana plant reported 34,369 lb of ethylene oxide air release in 2023, 21% of the US total
lead.number: 34,369 lb in 2023 (32,106 lb of it leaks), 8.7x its 2015-22 high and 21% of the 2023 national total (160,219 lb); back to 2,433 lb in 2024.
lead.watch_out: No skeptic has checked it, and a one-year spike is most likely a single upset event already reported to the state.

At approximately 9:15 p.m. on July 14, 2023, a series of explosions and fires occurred at Dow’s Glycol II unit, causing significant damage to nearby process equipment and resulting in the release of more than 31,000 pounds of toxic EtO, which is produced at the facility. EtO is a reactive and flammable chemical product and is a known human carcinogen. Local authorities issued a shelter-in-place order affecting hundreds of nearby residents.
